response: Yes, the horizontal semicircular canal ocular reflex is influenced by otolith organs input. The otolith organs, which include the utricle and saccule, provide information about linear acceleration and gravity, and they interact with the semicircular canals to help the vestibular system integrate rotational and linear motion signals. This interaction can modulate the gain and dynamics of the horizontal semicircular canal ocular reflex, allowing for more accurate and coordinated eye movements in response to complex head movements.
